title: COVID-19 RNA Extraction
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load lysed samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place the lysed COVID‑19 samples into a NEST 96‑deepwell plate positioned on the magnetic module in slot 4 of the OT‑2 deck.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Using the two 12‑channel reservoirs, add the binding buffer to each well of the sample plate as defined in the Setup section. If `park tips` is set to yes, park each tip in the corresponding well of an empty rack; if set to no, use a fresh tip for each addition.

steps.title: Perform three bead washes
steps.instruction: Carry out three consecutive magnetic bead wash steps on the magnetic module, aspirating and dispensing wash buffer from the 12‑channel reservoirs and removing supernatant between washes, following the protocol’s wash sequence.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: add wash buffer, incubate as required, remove supernatant.
Wash 2: repeat addition, incubation, and removal.
Wash 3: repeat addition, incubation, and removal.

steps.title: Elute RNA to chilled PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to a chilled PCR plate placed on the temperature module in slot 1, mapping each well directly (e.g., extraction plate A1 → elution plate A1, B1 → B1, … D2 → D2).

steps.title: Finalize robot setup and run
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file to the OT App, set up the deck according to the provided deck map, calibrate all labware and the pipette using the OT App, then press “Run”. Optional parameters: set `park tips`, `track tips across protocol runs`, and `flash` to yes or no as desired.

substeps.instruction: Upload protocol to the OT App.
Arrange deck items per the deck map.
